item.title: Past the Singularity, I Am the Only Bottleneck
item.description: Once frontier models cross one’s personal adaptive singularity, the barrier holding back a task retreats from the tool to oneself. Faced with a surplus of compute I cannot spend down, I have had to step out from the center of question-and-answer interaction and try to become the one who designs systems that run on their own.
